eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Diabetes type 2
* Non smokers
* Untrained
* Willingness to adhere to a diet intervention

Exclusion Criteria:

* Chronic disease
* Pregnancy
* Cancer
* Antibiotic therapy
* Drug/alcohol abuse
* Competitive athletes

official_title: Branched-Chain Amino Acid Dietary Reduction Under Weight Maintainance in Overweight Patients With Type 2 Diabetes
